Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

MicroBioMeta 0.99.0

NEW FEATURES

  • Initial submission to Bioconductor.
  • Functions for metabarcoding (16S/18S/ITS) and shotgun metagenomic (Kraken2/Bracken) tables with a taxonomy column, plus a metadata table:
    • Data preparation: merge_feature_taxonomy(), collapse_table(), from_phyloseq() and from_tse().
    • Composition: abundance_bar_plot(), abundance_heatmap_plot() and abundance_sankey_plot().
    • Alpha diversity: alpha_hill_corr_plot(), alpha_hill_plot(), alpha_diversity_plot(), alpha_decay_plot() and venn_plot().
    • Beta diversity: beta_ord_plot(), beta_test_table(), beta_partition_ord_plot(), beta_dissimilarity_plot(), beta_turnover_plot() and beta_decay_plot().
    • Differential abundance and important taxa: aldex_volcano_plot(), aldex_heatmap_plot(), ancombc_plot(), random_forest_lollipop_plot() and ratios_bubble_plot().
    • Environmental variables: corr_env_abund_plot() and cca_rda_biplot().
  • Bacterial phylum names are shown with their validly published names (e.g. Proteobacteria -> Pseudomonadota, Firmicutes -> Bacillota) in every function that uses taxonomy, with a message listing the changes.
  • Example 16S, 18S and Kraken2 datasets in inst/extdata, and vignettes in English and Spanish.

Developed by Stephanie Hereira Pacheco, Nina Montoya Ciriaco, Karla Zarco González.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
